text: Release readiness follow-ups: stable local ids on re-pull, editable URL for migrated rows, self-notification, status aggregate, one-server strings, docs

All ten items on main (HEAD 252661f5) as 12 cherry-picked commits, full gate green (core 114, app debug 758). Review: a pulled row takes its server id as local id when free, and a re-base hands back the local ids of the rows it drops, so mutes and the last-opened list survive; the URL of a migrated row stays editable until its server is confirmed and login adopts it; the aggregate status ignores signed-out/outdated accounts; no self-notification across two logins on one server; removal ends the server session best-effort (offline it waits for the HTTP timeout). Release notes: deploy the server, then install the app right away (landing-page link); set the floor table's Since to the release version.
